test-set.name: saxon-timestamp
test-set.description: Tests for the saxon:timestamp extension function introduced in Saxon 9.8

test-case.name: s-timestamp-002
test-case.description: Use saxon:timestamp in a loop (avoid optimization)
test-case.test: count(distinct-values(for $i in 1 to 20 return (for $j in 1 to 40000 return "Dummy"[$j lt 0], saxon:timestamp())))

test-case.name: s-timestamp-003
test-case.description: Check the value has a timezone
